subject.title: Warn when host approvals clamp exec security at startup

question: Should a host-approval clamp warning be emitted on every gateway server start, including an in-process SIGUSR1 restart, rather than once per CLI process launch?
rationale: The proposed code deliberately chooses once-per-launch behavior to avoid repeated log noise, while the linked report explicitly includes SIGUSR1 restart behavior; that product tradeoff cannot be inferred safely from source alone.

options.title: Warn on every gateway start
options.body: Move the diagnostic into the gateway loop start path and add a regression test for the SIGUSR1 restart lifecycle so both documented restart modes receive the warning.

options.title: Keep launch-only diagnostics
options.body: Retain the current once-per-process warning but remove or narrow the claim that this PR resolves the linked restart report’s SIGUSR1 scenario.

recommendation.title: Warn on every gateway start
recommendation.body: Move the diagnostic into the gateway loop start path and add a regression test for the SIGUSR1 restart lifecycle so both documented restart modes receive the warning.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the existing exec-policy command and remediation model that defines the operator-facing contract this warning extends.
